units.source_text: 右手握住离剪刀一米左右的绳索，他懂得甩绳的要领：在头上画个圈。

en.t: With his right hand he gripped the rope about a meter from the scissors, and he understood the trick of swinging it: draw a circle above his head.

units.source_text: 目标是那边的草包——大网篮吊上吊下时，代替滑轮的草包。

en.t: The target was the straw bundle over there, the bundle that served as a pulley when the big net basket was hoisted up and down.

units.source_text: 它既然能固定绳梯，一定埋得相当牢固。

en.t: Since it could hold the rope ladder in place, it must have been buried fairly firmly.

units.source_text: 他渐渐地把绳索越转越快，瞄准目标，唰地抛了出去。

en.t: He gradually spun the rope faster and faster, took aim at the target, and flung it out with a swish.

units.source_text: 谁知绳子却往完全相反的方向飞去。

en.t: But the rope flew off in the completely opposite direction.
He probably should not have thrown it outward.

units.source_text: 剪刀是沿着圆弧的切线飞去的，绳索对于目标，得选择时机出手，

en.t: The scissors flew along the tangent of the arc, so with the rope, he had to choose the right moment to release it toward the target,

units.source_text: 当绳索成为直角的瞬间，或再稍稍前一点，只要松开手就行了。

en.t: at the instant the rope formed a right angle, or just a little before that, all he had to do was let go.

units.source_text: ……但是，很遗憾，这回碰到了崖坝，掉了下去。

en.t: ... But unfortunately, this time it struck the cliff wall and fell down.

units.source_text: 好像是旋转速度和仰角取得不够。

en.t: It seemed that he had not gotten enough rotational speed or upward angle.
